ModuleName: Creating a Module: Three Methods and the Module Manager

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: A structured list of all topics covered in this module — from what a module is and why multiple creation methods exist, through each of the three creation methods and the Module Manager — used by authors and learners as a navigational outline of the module's scope.

Artifacts.Name: Overview of Module Creation in PreseMaker
Artifacts.Description: An introductory reading that explains what a module is in PreseMaker, why the application offers several creation methods, and how all pathways lead to the Module Manager, giving learners the conceptual foundation needed before exploring specific creation workflows.

Artifacts.Name: Method 1: Generating a New Module with AI
Artifacts.Description: A reading that walks learners through PreseMaker's AI-powered module generation method, covering how to access it, what inputs are required, and how the AI produces an initial module structure, so learners can use this approach to quickly scaffold a new module.

Artifacts.Name: Method 2: Adding an Existing Module Folder from Disk
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains how to bring an existing module folder stored on a local disk into PreseMaker without rebuilding it from scratch, detailing how to locate the folder and register it through the appropriate interface.

Artifacts.Name: Method 3: Importing from a File or Repository
Artifacts.Description: A reading that covers the third module creation method — importing a packaged module from a file or remote repository — explaining when to use this approach and how to complete the import process within PreseMaker.

Artifacts.Name: The Module Manager: Central Hub for Module Setup
Artifacts.Description: A reading that describes the Module Manager as PreseMaker's central interface for module setup, explaining what configuration options it consolidates and how learners and instructors use it after a module has been created by any of the three methods.

Artifacts.Name: From Empty Module to Content-Ready: The Module Lifecycle
Artifacts.Description: A reading that traces the full lifecycle of a PreseMaker module from initial creation through each setup stage to content-ready status, giving learners a mental model of the predictable sequence of steps any module follows.

Artifacts.Name: From Empty Module to Content-Ready: The Module Lifecycle
Artifacts.Description: A duplicate of the module lifecycle reading that traces the full lifecycle of a PreseMaker module from initial creation through each setup stage to content-ready status, giving learners a mental model of the predictable sequence of steps any module follows.
